headline: Nonprofit wants TXNM to hand $240 million to customers over ‘waived’ Blackstone termination fee
summary: An Albuquerque nonprofit wants TXNM Energy Inc. to dole out $240 million in rate credits to customers after state regulators voided a $400 million sale in the utility company’s stock to Blackstone Inc. In a Monday filing with the Public Regulation Commission, Albuquerque-based Prosperity Works cites a $350 million termination fee baked into an agreement for private equity firm Blackstone Inc. ...
